label: The ordinary-comparative gap attacks more such on its MORE_3 reading
note: Target: the MORE_3 sibling of 'more such' (every distinct cause of a quality in another is more such by measured degree, both having it formally). It does not target d5a94eb1, whose MoreIn is the primitive MORE_1; no statement identifies MORE_1 with MORE_3. Mechanism: induction transfers energy electromagnetically, so the cause of the workpiece's heat need not be hotter than it. Independent justification: standard induction-heating practice (water-cooled coil below about 60 °C, workpiece at roughly 800-1200 °C). Relevance: the consumers of d5a94eb1 that apply it at an arbitrary perfection with an arbitrary distinct cause would be reached if read with MORE_3: gradesHaveAMaximum 1dff22d0 and nothingMovesExceptInAct 892db443 (older derivations with siblings c201b61a and d0c022f8 that do not use d5a94eb1), and the Cartesian containmentOfStrictComparative 62dae664 and degreeAdequacyOfStrictComparative c974d1f0. Scope: it does not reach the MORE_4 reading, the esse uses (the coil causes no being), the cause-of-being uses at any perfection (preexistence 6b609ddc) or Metaphysics II.1's synonymous premise.
